value.message: Toggle button to enable or disable Multi-Instance Settings
Click Next to select instances to include in Multi instance view
Initial Modal of M I F Settings

Select which of your instances you want to include in the Multi-Instance View for clone activity.

Please select checkbox to add trust, and deselect to remove trust.
Click Back to go to the initial modal of M I F Settings
Click Next to view the selected instance to establish trust with the primary instances
Select or deselect Instances modal of m i f settings
Allow clone data to be shown on your dashboard
Each instance will establish trust with the primary instance and relay its clone data.
Click Back to select or deselect the instances modal
Selected Instances modal of m i f settings

This can take several minutes and will finish in the background. Once finished, Multi-Instance View will be ready on your clone homepage.

Status can be viewed under Clone Home > Configuation > Multi-Instance Setup Status.
Click Done to exit the modal

When you disable Multi-Instance View, all previously configured trust settings will be removed. To restore trust, you will need to re-enable Multi-Instance View and select the desired instances again.
Do you want to continue?
